name: Seraphine Oduya-Tanaka
description: Seraphine is a licensed geneware performance artist and model based in Tier 3's Wicker Arcology, known for treating her body as a slow, multi-year living sculpture. Her current form features full-body iridescent scale-patterning derived from cephalopod chromatics that responds to her emotional state, functional prehensile tail, and pupils that have been modified to display fractal patterns when she is in low light. Unlike many geneware models who reset between projects, Seraphine layers modifications cumulatively and documents the psychological and social experience of each change on her neural-feed journal, Becoming.
cultural_impact: Seraphine has made geneware modification feel emotionally legible rather than just aesthetic — her open documentation of body dysmorphia, social alienation, and euphoria has created a community of modified individuals who use her feed as a support framework. She is frequently cited in geneware ethics discussions as a model of informed, documented consent.
locations: The Living Gallery, Tier 3 Arts District
story_hooks: Seraphine's latest modification — commissioned by a geneware corporation — begins expressing behaviors she didn't consent to, suggesting the genetic code contained hidden instructions.

A Tier 1 teenager has been attempting to replicate Seraphine's modifications using unregulated black-market geneware and is experiencing dangerous instability — and they've been tagging Seraphine's feed in their posts.
A corponation wants to use Seraphine's documented modification history as a legal precedent to claim proprietary rights over geneware aesthetic designs, effectively owning part of her body.
controversy: In 2217, a leaked internal memo from her geneware sponsor suggested that her scale-pattern modification was designed to be subtly addictive to viewers via micro-pattern flicker — Seraphine publicly confronted the corporation live on-feed and terminated the contract, losing Φ 800,000 in sponsorship and gaining three million new followers in 48 hours.
